name: Artefakt
source:
This is a story about an adventurer who travels to the Sovyonok pioneer camp, and not for a vacation. The protagonist has to find the Artifact, which is located in the mines near the pioneer camp, but things aren't as simple as they seem. Will he be able to reach the coveted Artifact, or will circumstances get in his way? Or perhaps he will choose the path of love altogether.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2183199415]Steam[/url]]
